id_policy: Asset IDs name the subject and remain stable; version IDs name individual immutable candidates. SCN IDs name the existing 15 broad narrative scenes. Never renumber IDs to match a new order. Shot IDs will be assigned when shots are authored.

versions.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Generate ONE character reference image for Monsters Loose, asset CHAR-001 Zookeeper v001. Input image is the identity, costume, and visual-style reference, not a composition to reproduce. Show the SAME adult female zookeeper from the input, maintaining recognizable facial identity: dense freckles, pale warm skin, hazel-green eyes, auburn/copper curly chin-to-shoulder-length bob with short straight fringe, same facial proportions. Single full-length standing three-quarter-front reference portrait, entire head and boots in frame, natural competent relaxed stance, arms resting where uniform and hands can be clearly seen, alert and slightly wry closed-mouth expression. No multiple views or panels. Preserve olive short-sleeved button-front work shirt, practical trousers, dark utility belt, fingerless work gloves, M.U.C.F. dinosaur shoulder patch, HARPER name badge, hanging ZOO STAFF ID and existing practical gear. Finish unseen lower costume conservatively with olive work trousers and sturdy dark boots; these are candidate additions for approval. No extra weapons, creatures, hats, or unrelated accessories. Quiet plain warm parchment backdrop with subtle ground shadow. Match the original richly illustrated retro 1960s monster-comic / graphic-novel treatment: confident ink contours, detailed crosshatching and restrained halftone grain, earthy olive and warm paper palette, believable anatomy and dimensional face without becoming a glossy photograph or cartoon caricature. Even readable lighting on face and costume. Do not copy cover title, caption boxes, speech bubbles, alarm or background architecture. No large titles, no catalog ID burned into artwork. Only small original costume labels. High-quality reference image that can anchor consistent future generated scenes.
